name: Isis
subtitle: Divine Mother
description: Bring your team back from the afterlife and bless them with buffs!
lore: Isis is healer, protector, teacher, and sorceress. She prefers to remain uninvolved in the War of Pyramids, instead picking up the slack across Aaru where many of her fellow gods are distracted by the ongoing conflict. She has begun to hear Destiny’s calls, though so far she remains equally allied to Destiny and Order both, rather than choosing one over the other.
divinity_generator: Gain [30] Divinity when placing a [Buff] on an ally.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Awaken the ability: Theft of Thebes
Shield Multiplier +30%, Heal Multiplier +30%, DMG Reduction Multiplier +20%
Attunement Multiplier +50%, Armor Multiplier +30%, Weapon Multiplier +30%

skills.name: Theft of Thebes
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy with a 35% chance to steal a random [Buff]. Then spread 1 random [Buff] on this hero to all allies.
skills.awakening_bonus: Steal [Buff] will ignore the target's RES.

skills.name: Ankh Haven
skills.description: Place [mechanic:shield] on all allies then place [mechanic:def-up-ii] on all allies for 3 turns. Grants this hero an [Extra Turn].
skills.awakening_bonus: Additionally place [Mend] on all allies for 3 turns.

skills.name: Divine Intervention
skills.description: Revive all allies with 50% HP and 50% Turn Meter. If Horus is revived by this ability, place [mechanic:radiance-ii] on him for 2 turns.
skills.awakening_bonus: After reviving place [Immortal] on all allies for 2 turns.

skills.name: Mother's Embrace
skills.description: At the start of this hero’s turn, remove all [Debuffs] and [Disables] from the ally with the lowest HP, then heal them equal to 10% of this hero’s MAX HP.

imprint_passive: At the start of this hero’s turn, remove all [Debuffs] and [Disables] from the ally with the lowest HP, then heal them equal to 5% of this hero’s MAX HP.
